case_title: PACIFIC GAS AND ELECTRIC COMPANY VS P AND J UTILITY COMPANY

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,500.00 FILED BY PACIFIC GAS AND ELECTRIC COMPANY AS TO DEFENDANT P AND J UTILITY COMPANY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-04-1991 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 06
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT P AND J UTILITY COMPANY

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF PACIFIC GAS AND ELECTRIC COMPANY IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT P AND J UTILITY COMPANY STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
MOTION FOR RECONSIDERATION FILED BY PLAINTIFF PACIFIC GAS AND ELECTRIC COMPANY HEARING SET FOR APR-17-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 05
SC MOTION DISPOSITION MOTION FOR RECONSIDERATION OF APR-17-1992, GRANTED
SMALL CLAIMS DISPOSITION DEC-04-1991, CONTINUED BY COURT TO JUN-05-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 05

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF PACIFIC GAS AND ELECTRIC COMPANY RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT P AND J UTILITY COMPANY $500.00 PRINCIPAL, $44.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $544.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT AS TO DEFENDANT P AND J UTILITY COMPANY
